Keys across the circle are maximally dissonant. The pattern is mathematically closed and self-referential — a map, not a tool.

This same structure appears in our AI architecture. AI formula configurations map naturally to Circle of Fifths positions. Harmonically 'close' configurations produce synergistic results. 'Distant' configurations produce interference. We discovered this empirically — we did not design it in.
